description.zh: 血液走体循环与肺循环两个环路，由心脏的瓣膜和四个腔保证单向流动；同一流量下总横截面积越大流速越小，平均动脉压约等于心输出量乘外周阻力。仅为教学示意与近似数值，不用于医疗判断。
description.en: Blood travels a systemic and a pulmonary loop, kept one-way by the heart’s four chambers and valves; at the same flow a larger total cross-section means slower speed, and mean arterial pressure is roughly cardiac output times peripheral resistance. A teaching sketch with approximate numbers, not for medical judgement.

reason.zh: 整条回路里血流量相同，毛细血管的总横截面积最大，所以按 v = Q / A 流速最慢，血液有时间与组织交换物质。
reason.en: Flow is the same around the whole circuit and capillaries have the largest total cross-section, so v = Q / A makes them the slowest, leaving time to exchange material with tissue.

title.zh: 为什么毛细血管里血流最慢？
title.en: Why is blood slowest in the capillaries?

ask.zh: 心脏的瓣膜和四个腔保证血液单向流动——如果瓣膜关不严，血液会怎样流？
ask.en: The heart's valves and four chambers keep blood flowing one way — if a valve could not close properly, what would the blood do?

reveal.zh: 同一流量下总横截面积越大流速越小，毛细血管总面积最大，所以血流最慢，正好让物质有时间交换。
reveal.en: At the same flow, the wider the total cross-section the slower the flow; capillaries have the largest total area, so blood moves slowest there — exactly what lets substances exchange in time.
